items.author: Eric Summers, 2x Tableau Ambassador, Nov 18
items.summary: Rebuilt Tableau's Superstore Overview as a Data App, matching all seven numbers to the cent on 10,194 order lines. Reading every calc, filter and action exposed a stale saved Profit Ratio filter that blanked New Brunswick, the worst province, on the map; the app flags it in orange. 16 reactions, 4 comments, 1 repost.

items.author: Anastasiya Kuznetsova, BI Team Lead, Tableau Ambassador, Nov 18
items.summary: Five bar-chart mistakes that show up in both AI and human work: meaningless colors, a tiny title and gaps, sausage-like bars, hard-to-scan labels, and an axis that repeats the bar values. A good viz skill helps, but review still matters. Carousel. 21 reactions, 4 comments, 1 repost.
